beats.narration_slice: Prometheus steals fire and gives it to humanity.
beats.visual: In a weathered mineral fresco, bronze-relief Prometheus crouches at the edge of a divine brazier, lifting a small gold-inlaid flame toward a cluster of waiting human figures below.
beats.purpose: show Prometheus taking divine fire and passing it to humanity
beats.visual_fingerprint: Prometheus in profile at upper left; stolen flame crossing diagonally downward toward three small terracotta human figures; dark temple ledge behind; strong low raking light on raised bronze edges
beats.continuity: opens the mythic body with the act that triggers Zeus's retaliation

beats.narration_slice: Zeus answers by ordering Pandora to be created.
beats.visual: Zeus dominates a shallow bronze-relief throne composition, one carved hand extended in command toward an unfinished terracotta female figure emerging from raw clay.
beats.purpose: show Zeus ordering Pandora's creation as his response
beats.visual_fingerprint: low-angle throne scene; Zeus large at upper center; unfinished Pandora torso rising from a clay mound at lower right; command gesture linked by a restrained gold line; storm-dark charcoal background
beats.continuity: cuts from Prometheus's theft to Zeus initiating a deliberate countermeasure

beats.narration_slice: The Olympian gods furnish her with gifts.
beats.visual: Pandora stands frontally like a painted cult figure while stylized Olympian hands enter from the fresco margins offering a woven veil, a bronze ornament, and symbolic gifts around her.
beats.purpose: show the Olympian gods furnishing Pandora with gifts
beats.visual_fingerprint: centered full-length Pandora; disembodied relief hands entering from four edges; veil, clasp, garland, and small gold-inlaid token arranged around her; limestone cream plaster field
beats.continuity: develops the newly created Pandora into the fully furnished figure Zeus intends to send

beats.narration_slice: Then Zeus sends Pandora to Prometheus's brother, Epimetheus.
beats.visual: A frieze-like procession shows Pandora moving across a rocky Aegean path toward Epimetheus waiting beside a low stone dwelling, while Zeus remains as a distant elevated silhouette behind her.
beats.purpose: show Pandora being sent by Zeus to Epimetheus
beats.visual_fingerprint: wide vertical procession; Pandora walking mid-frame from upper left toward Epimetheus at lower right; stepped rocky path; distant Zeus silhouette on high ridge; sparse ochre landscape
beats.continuity: moves Pandora out of the divine setting and toward the mortal household where the consequence unfolds

beats.narration_slice: Prometheus had already warned Epimetheus not to trust gifts from Zeus.
beats.visual: Prometheus grips Epimetheus by the forearm in a tense bronze-relief warning scene, while a small sealed gift vessel symbol is carved between them and a distant Zeus emblem looms beyond.
beats.purpose: show Prometheus warning Epimetheus against accepting Zeus's gifts
beats.visual_fingerprint: tight two-figure profile composition; Prometheus at left raising a cautioning finger; Epimetheus at right turning away; tiny sealed vessel between their chests; blackened plaster niche background
beats.continuity: interrupts Pandora's approach with the warning Epimetheus had received beforehand

beats.narration_slice: Epimetheus accepts Pandora anyway.
beats.visual: Epimetheus extends both hands toward Pandora across a threshold, accepting her into the household despite the prior warning.
beats.purpose: show Epimetheus accepting Pandora despite Prometheus's warning
beats.visual_fingerprint: medium threshold shot; Epimetheus inside shadowed doorway on right; Pandora outside in sun-baked ochre light on left; their hands nearly joined at center; vertical stone doorposts frame the scene
beats.continuity: resolves the warning scene by showing Epimetheus make the opposite choice

beats.narration_slice: Beside her stands the object later remembered as a box.
beats.visual: Pandora stands in profile beside a tall broad-shouldered terracotta storage vessel whose massive scale is immediately visible, with no chest anywhere in the scene.
beats.purpose: introduce the object later remembered as Pandora's box
beats.visual_fingerprint: full-body Pandora at left; monumental pithos occupying most of right half; vessel reaches nearly to her shoulder; plain plaster floor and wall; dramatic raking highlight along jar rim
beats.continuity: keeps Pandora at the household but shifts attention from the characters to the famous object beside her

beats.narration_slice: But Hesiod's vessel is a pithos.
beats.visual: The composition isolates the monumental pithos like an archaeological specimen, centered against worn limestone plaster with its thick mouth, broad belly, and storage-vessel proportions emphasized by low light.
beats.purpose: reveal that Hesiod's vessel is specifically a pithos
beats.visual_fingerprint: single centered vessel with no figures; low eye-level museum-object view; broad terracotta body fills most of frame; oxidized teal repair marks and sparse gold edge accents; deep umber floor shadow
beats.continuity: removes Pandora from frame so the vessel itself becomes the discovery

beats.narration_slice: A pithos is a large storage jar, not a chest.
beats.visual: A clean cutaway-style fresco diagram shows the pithos embedded partly into a storage floor with stacked grain jars nearby, while a tiny simplified chest silhouette sits off to one side for scale contrast without text.
beats.purpose: explain that a pithos is a large storage jar rather than a chest
beats.visual_fingerprint: sectional storage-room view; giant pithos sunk into floor at center; grain forms visible inside; two smaller jars behind; tiny closed chest shape at far lower corner; diagrammatic cream background
beats.continuity: turns the isolated object reveal into a functional explanation of the vessel's size and use

beats.narration_slice: Pandora opens the jar.
beats.visual: From a high three-quarter angle, Pandora braces one hand on the enormous pithos and lifts its heavy lid with the other as darkness becomes visible inside.
beats.purpose: show Pandora opening the pithos
beats.visual_fingerprint: high-angle action shot; Pandora bent over vessel at lower center; circular mouth dominates frame; lid tilted upward toward top right; narrow gold rim catches light around a black interior
beats.continuity: returns Pandora to the vessel after establishing what a pithos actually is

beats.narration_slice: Hardships pour out into human life.
beats.visual: Abstract charcoal and oxidized-teal hardship forms erupt upward from the open pithos and stream outward into a distant band of small human silhouettes, avoiding literal monsters.
beats.purpose: show hardships escaping from the jar into human life
beats.visual_fingerprint: extreme vertical eruption; pithos mouth at bottom edge; twisting smoke-like carved forms rise through center then fan outward toward tiny human silhouettes near top; sparse gold flecks overwhelmed by charcoal shapes
beats.continuity: expands the darkness revealed inside the open jar into the consequences escaping from it

beats.narration_slice: She closes the lid, but not before they are gone.
beats.visual: Pandora forces the heavy lid back onto the pithos while the final abstract hardship trails vanish beyond the frame behind her.
beats.purpose: show Pandora closing the jar after the hardships have already escaped
beats.visual_fingerprint: side-on medium action shot; Pandora leaning across vessel at right; lid descending diagonally; last thin charcoal ribbons exiting upper left; empty ochre space behind emphasizes their departure
beats.continuity: follows the eruption with Pandora's too-late attempt to contain what has escaped

beats.narration_slice: One thing remains inside: Elpis.
beats.visual: The sealed pithos is shown in a simplified cutaway, its dark interior empty except for one small enclosed gold-teal ember resting at the bottom.
beats.purpose: show that one thing, Elpis, remains inside the jar
beats.visual_fingerprint: centered cutaway vessel against limestone cream; thick terracotta walls shown in section; tiny luminous ember isolated at the lowest point; exterior sealed and still
beats.continuity: moves from the closed exterior to a revealing interior view

beats.narration_slice: Elpis is often translated as hope.
beats.visual: The small enclosed ember becomes a delicate sprouting flame-like form inside the pithos, visually suggesting hope while remaining ambiguous and contained.
beats.purpose: connect Elpis with the common translation of hope
beats.visual_fingerprint: macro interior view from inside the jar; single gold-inlaid ember at center grows into a small plant-flame shape; curved terracotta walls surround it like a dark cavern
beats.continuity: develops the remaining ember into the familiar hopeful interpretation

beats.narration_slice: What that remaining hope means is still debated.
beats.visual: The pithos sits between two opposing carved gestures: one open hand reaching toward the contained glow and one closed hand shielding it, creating a balanced unresolved composition with no text.
beats.purpose: show the uncertainty over whether retained hope is beneficial, withheld, or otherwise ambiguous
beats.visual_fingerprint: symbolic symmetrical composition; pithos centered; open bronze-relief hand enters from left; closed terracotta hand enters from right; small interior glow visible between them
beats.continuity: turns the hopeful image into a deliberate visual ambiguity rather than a settled answer

beats.narration_slice: That ambiguity changes the story's ending.
beats.visual: A winding carved path reaches the sealed pithos and then splits into two unfinished branches, one touched by faint gold light and the other disappearing into charcoal shadow.
beats.purpose: show that the unresolved meaning of Elpis changes how the ending can be interpreted
beats.visual_fingerprint: top-down symbolic landscape; narrow incised path rises from bottom to centered sealed pithos; two divergent branches continue above it; left branch faintly illuminated, right branch eroded into shadow
beats.continuity: takes the opposing interpretations from the previous beat and shows them producing different endings

beats.narration_slice: Pandora is not simply a villain.
beats.visual: Pandora appears alone in a restrained bronze-and-terracotta portrait, neither menacing nor triumphant, with her face turned toward the sealed jar in a quiet, conflicted profile.
beats.purpose: reframe Pandora as more complex than a simple villain
beats.visual_fingerprint: close profile portrait occupying left two-thirds; Pandora's lowered gaze directed toward small blurred pithos at lower right; neutral mineral-plaster background; soft raking light without sinister shadow motifs
beats.continuity: shifts from abstract interpretation back to Pandora herself and removes the visual language of blame

beats.narration_slice: She is part of Zeus's punishment after Prometheus steals fire.
beats.visual: A causal frieze places Zeus at the top, Pandora in the middle, and Prometheus with the stolen flame below, linked by carved directional forms that frame Pandora as one part of Zeus's larger response.
beats.purpose: show Pandora's role within Zeus's punishment for Prometheus's theft
beats.visual_fingerprint: stacked vertical cause-and-effect relief; Zeus seated at top tier; Pandora standing in middle tier; Prometheus carrying flame at bottom tier; three separated stone bands connected by descending incised motifs
beats.continuity: widens from Pandora's portrait to the larger chain of actions that defines her role

beats.narration_slice: The famous box belongs to later tradition.
beats.visual: The ancient pithos remains sharp in the foreground while, behind it, a later small chest-like form appears only as a faint worn shadow layered onto a younger plaster surface.
beats.purpose: show that the familiar box image is a later development in the tradition
beats.visual_fingerprint: depth-layered artifact composition; monumental pithos sharp at lower foreground; faint chest silhouette high in background on newer cracked plaster; contrasting surface ages make the chronology visual without text
beats.continuity: moves from the original mythic chain to how the vessel's image changed in later retelling

beats.narration_slice: The older story leaves us with a jar and an unresolved hope.
beats.visual: The final mythic image shows the monumental sealed pithos alone at dusk-like low light, with one faint gold-teal glow visible through a narrow crack near its base and vast empty plaster space above.
beats.purpose: end on the original jar and the unresolved presence of hope
beats.visual_fingerprint: solitary pithos low in the vertical frame; vessel centered slightly below midpoint; enormous quiet limestone wall above; tiny gold-teal glow leaking from a hairline crack; long deep umber shadow extending toward viewer
beats.continuity: strips away the later chest image and closes on the two enduring elements of the older story: the jar and unresolved Elpis
